metadata.description: An AI-powered platform for creating polished presentations.

adminHome.title: Admin Console
adminHome.subtitle: Manage platform accounts and operations entry points. When you need to create PPTs, enter the creation workbench from here.

users.title: User Management
users.body: Review accounts, roles, active status, and account-scoped data, then adjust user access when needed.

templates.title: Template Workspace
templates.body: Manage the PPT template library, page categories, and reusable page JSON assets for future generation workflows.

workbench.title: Creation Workbench
workbench.body: Enter the regular creation flow for PPT slide splitting, visual specs, and page element planning.

providers.summary: Manage OpenAI-compatible model providers for the current account. API keys can only be replaced or cleared, and plaintext keys are never shown.

models.summary: The default LLM powers this account's home chat responses. Only one enabled model from an available provider can be the default at a time.

general.title: General Settings

account.title: Account Settings
account.body: Email/password accounts are now used to isolate your AI configuration.

appearance.title: Appearance Settings
appearance.body: Light, dark, and system modes can be switched from appearance settings.

embeddings.title: Embedding Models
embeddings.body: Embedding models will be added after knowledge-base and retrieval features land.

about.title: About PPT Creator Master
about.body: PPT Creator Master is created by SJQ (Mumihe) and designed Chinese-first.

embeddings.title: Embedding Model Management
embeddings.summary: Manage embedding models for future knowledge-base and retrieval features. Provider, key, and Base URL come from AI provider settings.

imageModels.title: Image Model Management
imageModels.summary: Manage models used for PPT image layers. Provider, key, and Base URL come from AI provider settings.

adminUsers.subtitle: Review account status, administrator access, and account-scoped data. Disable accounts when needed and clear sessions immediately.

adminTemplates.subtitle: Manage reusable PPT templates by page type. Each template stores a complete page JSON and can be adjusted in the visual designer.

createPanel.description: Create a template for the current {category} category from the default pattern or a JSON import.
createPanel.defaultHint: Copy the current category's default page JSON, then continue editing in the designer.
createPanel.fileHint: Supports the full import format and raw SlideCompositionPlan JSON.

designer.noElementSelected: Select an element on the canvas or in the layer list to edit content, position, style, and image request settings.
designer.newElementNotes: New element. Adjust its style and position as needed.

designer.defaultNegativePrompt: No text, no watermark, no complex background, no low-resolution artifacts
designer.defaultImageNotes: Keep it presentation-ready, clean-edged, and suitable for page layering.

adminTemplateAssets.searchPlaceholder: Search names, descriptions, sets, semantics, keywords, page types, styles, or backgrounds
adminTemplateAssets.empty: No assets in this category yet

icons.title: Icon Management
icons.subtitle: Manage reusable icon assets, including line, filled, duotone, and monochrome configurations for later semantic element generation.
icons.defaultDescription: A line icon for ideas, features, metrics, or process nodes.

shapes.title: Shape Management
shapes.subtitle: Manage basic shape assets such as cards, containers, badges, and background blocks for page structure and visual emphasis.
shapes.defaultDescription: A rounded container shape for body copy, metrics, or comparison content.

lines.title: Line Management
lines.subtitle: Manage connector, arrow, timeline, and divider assets for processes, relationships, and page separation.
lines.defaultDescription: An arrow line for step flow, relationship direction, or connecting page regions.

form.description: Manage the name, tags, usage scenarios, and JSON configuration. Style and preview JSON must be objects.

sections.basicSummary: Manage the set, categories, name, status, and description.
sections.discoverySummary: Configure keywords, semantics, page types, and style tags used by AI retrieval.
sections.jsonSummary: Edit style, resource parameters, and preview configuration. All three must be JSON objects.
sections.permissionsSummary: Control which visual properties AI may adjust when reusing the asset.

confirm.delete: Delete asset "{name}"? This cannot be undone.

textStyles.title: Text Style Management
textStyles.subtitle: Manage reusable text hierarchy styles such as titles, subtitles, body copy, bullets, quotes, tags, headers, footers, and number emphasis.
textStyles.defaultDescription: A reusable text style for title, page heading, or body hierarchy.

containers.title: Container Management
containers.subtitle: Manage cards, info boxes, chart areas, image areas, column containers, list containers, placeholders, and conclusion boxes.
containers.defaultDescription: A reusable container for body copy, images, charts, or conclusion content.

navigation.title: Navigation Management
navigation.subtitle: Manage table of contents, section titles, page numbers, progress bars, step numbers, and current-position indicators.
navigation.defaultDescription: A navigation component for page numbers, sections, or progress state at a fixed position.

workbench.title: Creation Workbench
workbench.subtitle: Generate a complete presentation with preview, download, and saved history.

idea.label: Source Text / Idea
idea.placeholder: Paste long-form source text, or enter a complete idea. Example: Prepare an investor pitch for a clean energy startup covering market opportunity, product advantage, and partnership path.

textFiles.label: Text Files
textFiles.formats: Supports txt / md / csv / json / docx files
textFiles.tooLarge: Files larger than 10 MB were ignored

validation.idea: Enter source text or an idea with at least 10 characters.
validation.pageCount: Slide count must be an integer from 3 to 18.

loading.outlineDescription: AI is expanding the confirmed structure outline into per-slide copy JSON and a unified global visual spec.
loading.generateDescription: AI is composing page layers, image requests, review notes, consistency checks, and the PPTX from the confirmed outline.
loading.generateBackgroundTitle: Generation is continuing in the background

loading.missingOutlinePayload: No confirmed outline input was found. Return to the input page and submit again.

loading.intentProgress: Generating audience, goal, core message, and recommended slide count.
loading.outlineProgress: Generating the structure outline, per-slide copy JSON, and unified global visual spec.

loading.generateBackgroundProgress: This task is taking longer than usual, but it has not failed. Stay here to open the preview automatically, or return to input and find it in history after it completes.

intent.title: Confirm Input Analysis
intent.subtitle: Review the AI analysis of audience, goal, core message, and slide count. PPT type remains the scene structure reference for later generation.
intent.footerMeta: After confirmation, this structure outline will be expanded into per-slide copy JSON and a unified global visual spec.

outline.title: Outline Draft
outline.reviewSubtitle: Review the AI outline first. Use Edit when changes are needed; the preview PPT will strictly use the saved outline.
outline.readonlyHint: The saved outline is shown read-only by default. Use Edit to adjust titles, directory, slide copy, and the unified visual spec.

imageLayers.title: Image Layer Requests
imageLayers.empty: This slide does not need generated image layers yet.

mock.summaryPattern: A {count}-slide {deckType} deck for {audience}, organized around "{goal}" with a {palette} visual direction.

slideTemplates.title: Opening Frame
slideTemplates.body: Set the boundary of the topic with one clear judgment: {idea}.

slideTemplates.title: Audience Problem
slideTemplates.body: Place the key friction, opportunity, and decision criteria for {audience} on one slide.

slideTemplates.title: Solution Path
slideTemplates.body: Use a three-part structure to move from current state to target outcome.

slideTemplates.title: Evidence and Highlights
slideTemplates.body: Select the data, cases, or product capabilities that best support the argument.

slideTemplates.title: Visual Expression
slideTemplates.body: Turn complex relationships into a chart, flow, or comparison matrix.

slideTemplates.title: Risks and Responses
slideTemplates.body: Address likely concerns from {audience} before they surface.

slideTemplates.title: Execution Rhythm
slideTemplates.body: Break the work into near-term actions, milestones, and roles.

slideTemplates.title: Resource Plan
slideTemplates.body: Show the resources, capabilities, and boundaries needed to achieve "{goal}".

slideTemplates.title: Value Return
slideTemplates.body: Connect investment, return, efficiency, and impact in one logic line.

slideTemplates.title: Next Step
slideTemplates.body: Offer one concrete, low-friction, confirmable action.

slideTemplates.title: Appendix
slideTemplates.body: Keep definitions, data notes, and supporting material available.
